description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 99. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. 00-page-0.json holds page 0 for blocks 0 to 99 with a release, and is valid JSON after its first three bytes, a UTF-8 byte order mark. RFC 8259 JSON text carries no byte order mark, and a page file is read as strict UTF-8 standard JSON (clause 12), so the file cannot be parsed and refuses the whole census. Expected: the census refuses; no totals.
